settings.advanced.subagentPreferredProvi: Default Provider id for agent nodes (orchestrate_agents / workflows, cross-provider); empty = main provider. For hard tasks the model may pick another model under the same provider (e.g. Pro) via the node model field.
settings.advanced.toolLoadingMode.hint: Adaptive mode predicts the task and loads only relevant tools; AI can search and load more when needed. It applies to both Claude CLI and OpenAI-compatible engines.
settings.advanced.summarySingleShotMax.h: Summaries whose estimate stays under this cap go in one call; larger ones are chunked automatically. A 32K single shot measured 40–51s (22-S0 baseline) against a 180s remote summary timeout — the 64K tier hugs that line and risks wasted calls on slow models. Applies only while the experimental summary single-shot preference switch is on.
settings.advanced.workflowMaxNodes.hint: Maximum nodes in one persistent DAG workflow run (graph editor/templates). Range: 1–64; default: 48. This is separate from the per-turn subagent budget.
settings.advanced.agentNodeWrapUp.hint: After one model node runs this long, the orchestrator asks it to stop expanding and summarize now. If it still does not finish during the grace period, only that node is stopped. Set to 0 to disable.
settings.agentRoles.hint: The same roles work with OpenAI-compatible APIs and Claude CLI. Claude uses native --agents, and project .claude/agents are discovered automatically.
